name: National MILO Marathon 2026 – Tagbilaran Leg
short_description: A 2026 MILO Marathon leg in Tagbilaran City, Philippines, featuring distances from 1km up to a 21.1km half-marathon.
ai_summary: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Tagbilaran Leg is scheduled for September 13, 2026, in Tagbilaran City, Philippines. Registration status has not yet been confirmed as open.

faqs.question: When is the National MILO Marathon 2026 – Tagbilaran Leg?
faqs.answer: The race is scheduled to take place on September 13, 2026. This date applies to all distance categories offered at the Tagbilaran Leg, which is one of several city legs organized under the National MILO Marathon series by RUNRIO Inc. for that year.

faqs.answer: Runners can choose from five distance options: 1km, 3km, 5km, 10km, and 21.1km. The 21.1km half-marathon is listed as the primary distance for this event, making it suitable for both casual participants and more experienced long-distance runners looking for a bigger challenge.
